chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad, from Muʿallā ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn Asbāṭ, from ʿAlī ibn Manṣūr, from Ibrāhīm ibn ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd, from al-Walīd ibn Ṣabīḥ, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.
That is because, when Allah alone and the people of al-Wilāyah were invoked, you disbelieved.

key_terms.أَهْلُ الْوَلَايَةِ: the people of al-Wilāyah, those vested with divinely mandated authority
key_terms.اللَّهُ: Allah, the One to whom the call is directed
key_terms.كَفَرْتُمْ: you disbelieved, meaning you rejected the call being made

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith relate Qur'an 40:12 to al-Wilāyah?
ai.summary: This report presents the verse in connection with al-Wilāyah, linking rejection of the people of al-Wilāyah with disbelief when the call is made to Allah alone. In Shia hadith context, it serves as a quranic commentary emphasizing the theological significance of wilayah alongside tawhid.
